S.FORM: pnba maki yow na gaga na ms'unan te utux, gaga na iyik musa magal knerin innagan btiyux gluw na ina ro prasun naha sali ina, mrkyas ro yaba yaya nya, mtswe, ro gluw nya, ro lpyung ga mso'un musa magal ina, gluw knerin ga mnaga mwah gluw mlikuy ro lmon samow urow kya kwara y'aya rasun, wa tegan gluw mlikuy kwara y'aya ro s'agal nya, binah ga mrkyas sbi' nya y'aya yutas yaki, utux utux thawak ga sbi' nya msswe na ina, mkita sa'ing mrkyas laga, ina ga lmon tinun lukus ro splukus nya likuy nya lukus, toyah, snyuw tunux, yubing tutoh, skayal nya likuy nya malax lukus nya micu ro, splukus nya kwara lukus tnunan nya, tmsu'an gaga magal knerin laga, p'abi kya utux gbyan, ptna' gbyan kya ga mlahuy sm'as. te saying, gaga na psbinah sali innagan knerin mybuw cugan sasan, mlikuy hiya ga p'aras sragi na knerin htuw tanux, beta cka tu'iy musa sali ga musa mung owas na sili', myasa yow na mita sili' ga psbinah panga knerin mlikuy ro lmon musa, yaba yaya, msswe, gluw na ina hiya ga satu naha la'iy naha knerin, ro tputing mwah uy, kwara knerin gluw na mlikuy ga miyuk sali, mnaga ro mtama 'pa na mlikuy nya, ina ga sbi' pala yaba yaya, msswe na mlikuy, gluw na mlikuy hiya ga mwah msli sali uy, s'agan naha sinuw ro uwow knaley naha, gmluw gluw na ina mso'un mani' ro mnbuw uwow, mso'un mowas ro miyiy, beta masu' pn'as.
S.PHON: pnβa maki jow na ɣaɣa na m[s|ɕ]ʔunan te utux ɣaɣa na ijik mu[s|ɕ]a maɣal knerin innaɣan βtijux ɣluw na ina ro pra[s|ɕ]un naħa [s|ɕ]ali ina mrkja[s|ɕ] ro jaβa jaja nja mt[s|ɕ]we ro ɣluw nja ro lpjuŋ ɣa m[s|ɕ]oʔun mu[s|ɕ]a maɣal ina ɣluw knerin ɣa mnaɣa mwaħ ɣluw mlikuj ro lmon [s|ɕ]amow urow kja kwara jʔaja ra[s|ɕ]un wa teɣan ɣluw mlikuj kwara jʔaja ro [s|ɕ]ʔaɣal nja βinaħ ɣa mrkja[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]βiʔ nja jʔaja juta[s|ɕ] jaki utux utux tħawak ɣa [s|ɕ]βiʔ nja m[s|ɕ][s|ɕ]we na ina mkita [s|ɕ]aʔiŋ mrkja[s|ɕ] laɣa ina ɣa lmon tinun luku[s|ɕ] ro [s|ɕ]pluku[s|ɕ] nja likuj nja luku[s|ɕ] tojaħ [s|ɕ]njuw tunux juβiŋ tutoħ [s|ɕ]kajal nja likuj nja malax luku[s|ɕ] nja mi[ʦ|ʨ]u ro [s|ɕ]pluku[s|ɕ] nja kwara luku[s|ɕ] tnunan nja tm[s|ɕ]uʔan ɣaɣa maɣal knerin laɣa pʔaβi kja utux ɣβjan ptnaʔ ɣβjan kja ɣa mlaħuj [s|ɕ]mʔa[s|ɕ] te [s|ɕ]ajiŋ ɣaɣa na p[s|ɕ]βinaħ [s|ɕ]ali innaɣan knerin mjβuw [ʦ|ʨ]uɣan [s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]an mlikuj ħija ɣa pʔara[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]raɣi na knerin ħtuw tanux βeta [ʦ|ʨ]ka tuʔij mu[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]ali ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a muŋ owa[s|ɕ] na [s|ɕ]iliʔ mja[s|ɕ]a jow na mita [s|ɕ]iliʔ ɣa p[s|ɕ]βinaħ paŋa knerin mlikuj ro lmon mu[s|ɕ]a jaβa jaja m[s|ɕ][s|ɕ]we ɣluw na ina ħija ɣa [s|ɕ]atu naħa laʔij naħa knerin ro tputiŋ mwaħ uj kwara knerin ɣluw na mlikuj ɣa mijuk [s|ɕ]ali mnaɣa ro mtama ʔpa na mlikuj nja ina ɣa [s|ɕ]βiʔ pala jaβa jaja m[s|ɕ][s|ɕ]we na mlikuj ɣluw na mlikuj ħija ɣa mwaħ m[s|ɕ]li [s|ɕ]ali uj [s|ɕ]ʔaɣan naħa [s|ɕ]inuw ro uwow knalej naħa ɣmluw ɣluw na ina m[s|ɕ]oʔun maniʔ ro mnβuw uwow m[s|ɕ]oʔun mowa[s|ɕ] ro mijij βeta ma[s|ɕ]uʔ pnʔa[s|ɕ]
